description: Uses extreme value theory (GEV distribution) to predict expected delay of next record and optimal search range.
mathematical_formalization: P(D_n <= d) ~ exp(-(1 + xi*(d-mu_n)/sigma_n)^{-1/xi}). Fit from known records.
implementation_hypothesis: Fit GEV to 131 known records (delay vs log(n)). Predict record #132 and optimal search range.
experiment_seed: GEV fit, cross-validate by removing last 10 records.
